title: The PLA Watch: Carriers, Drones, and the Rocket Force's Manning Problem
dek: A far-sea exercise paired Liaoning with an amphibious assault ship formation. Two quieter reports, on reduced-manning missile operations and a PLA-wide drone contest, showed where the force still sees friction beneath its modernization drive.
signal: The clearest signal this week was Liaoning training in the Western Pacific alongside an amphibious assault ship formation, a pairing worth watching if it begins to recur.
